## setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(broom)
library(fixest)
library(texreg)
library(knitr)

load(here("data", "d_020626.Rdata"))
```

# Main Analyses

## Lag 0

```{r}

# model 1: regular eg, no current partisanship
mb1_l0 <- feols(imr_b ~ eg_z + prop_rep_planwriters_z + top10share_z + inc_z
                | state + year, 
                data = lag0)

mw1_l0 <- feols(imr_w ~ eg_z + prop_rep_planwriters_z + top10share_z + inc_z
                | state + year, 
                data = lag0)

#model 2: regular eg, current partisanship
mb2_l0 <- feols(imr_b ~ eg_z + prop_rep_planwriters_z + top10share_z + inc_z +
                  prop_rep_z | state + year, data = lag0)

mw2_l0 <- feols(imr_w ~ eg_z + prop_rep_planwriters_z + top10share_z + inc_z +
                  prop_rep_z | state + year, data = lag0)
```

## Model Fit

```{r}

list(mb1_l0, mb1_l1, mb1_l2, mb1_l3, mb2_l0, mb2_l1, mb2_l2, mb2_l3) |> 
  set_names(c("mb1_l0", "mb1_l1", "mb1_l2", "mb1_l3", "mb2_l0", "mb2_l1", "mb2_l2", "mb2_l3")) |> 
  map(~fitstat(.x, type = c("aic", "bic")))


list(mw1_l0, mw1_l1, mw1_l2, mw1_l3, mw2_l0, mw2_l1, mw2_l2, mw2_l3) |> 
  set_names(c("mw1_l0", "mw1_l1", "mw1_l2", "mw1_l3", "mw2_l0", "mw2_l1", "mw2_l2", "mw2_l3")) |> 
  map(~fitstat(.x, type = c("aic", "bic")))



```

## Main Tables

```{r}

list(mb1_l3, mw1_l3, mb2_l3, mw2_l3) |> 
  map(~fitstat(.x, type = "aic"))
  
list(mb1_l3, mw1_l3, mb2_l3, mw2_l3) |> 
  map(~fitstat(.x, type = "bic"))

texreg::wordreg(list(mb1_l3, 
             mw1_l3, 
             mb2_l3, 
             mw2_l3),
                  custom.model.names = 
          c("Model 1 (Black)", 
            "Model 1 (White)", 
            "Model 2 (Black)", 
            "Model 2 (White)"),
                  custom.coef.names = c("Efficiency Gap", "Proportion Republican: Last Redistricting", "Top 10%'s Share of Income", "Median Income", "Proportion Republican: Current"),
                  include.adjrs = F,
                  custom.gof.rows = list( 
                                         "AIC" = c("2,360.4",
                                                   "816.0",
                                                   "2,362.2",
                                                   "815.2"),
                                         "BIC" = c("2,609.9", 
                                                   "1,065.5", 
                                                   "2,616.2", 
                                                   "1,069.2")),
                  reorder.gof = (c(3,4,5,1,2,6,7)),
        single.row = T,
        file = "tables/mainresulttables.docx")
```

# Supplemental Analyses

## Absolute Value

### Lag 0

```{r}
#model 3: abs value eg, no current partisanship

                 | state + year, data = lag0)
mw3_l0 <-  feols(imr_w ~ eg_abs_z + prop_rep_planwriters_z + top10share_z + inc_z 
                 | state + year, data = lag0)
```
